notes.title: Answer the Survey and Redeem Rewards!
notes.notes:
Hi!

Participate in the survey and claim a free game or course product! You can choose any game product from F-Games' selection as your reward. When you have responded to the survey, send the information to my profile on Steam or via email (below). The survey is anonymous, but you can, for example, indicate your country when responding, or if you filled out the contact information form at the end of the survey, you can provide your first name. You can also choose to only fill out the contact information form at the end of the survey, and I will send you a link to the game prize list.

By responding to the survey, you also provide valuable information that will assist in the development of my courses and, of course, in the field of education and training in general after the research is completed!

I would be grateful if you could find time to answer the research! As a reward, you can choose any course product from my selection (The selection consists of the courses I have created.). Game rewards are also available. The survey is conducted anonymously.

[b]You can access the survey here:[/b]

[url=https://link.webropolsurveys.com/S/43E7490C029BD900]Link to the Survey[/url]


You can also access the survey by scanning this QR-code by your phone:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32088512/59a1cf76abc8d3b1737b3cee124f9d7fcd3b0a94.png[/img]

This research is part of Business Information Technology thesis.

The study aims to gain an understanding of the impact of virtual learning platforms on learning and learning outcomes.

[b]The survey covers various interesting themes:[/b]


[i]Theme 1: Learning Styles

Theme 2: Motivational Factors and Positive Experiences with Virtual Learning

Theme 3: Negative Experiences with Virtual Learning

Theme 4: Game-Based Learning

Theme 5: Utilizing Artificial Intelligence in Learning and Teaching
[/i]


I would appreciate it if you could find the time to respond to the survey! It should take approximately 10-20 minutes to complete. Please respond to the survey by October 6, 2023 (end of Saturday on your time zone)

You can choose to answer open-ended questions in your native language (the survey is international). Mandatory questions are marked with asterisks.

If you wish, you can also have access to the research results as the study provides valuable information to the education field.

Receive a game or course product for free as a reward

The survey is conducted anonymously, but if you would like to receive a free game product or course product as a reward, or participate in a special product drawing, please leave your contact information below. You can choose a game or course product from the list. A list of available game and course products to choose from will be sent to you via email.

If you wish, you can also provide open feedback. You can leave feedback anonymously as well. If you want a response to your feedback or wish to receive the survey results once they are available, please remember to leave your contact information below.

We will also contact you via email regarding the results of the drawing, so please make sure to enter your email address in the field! The drawing will take place within 2-4 weeks after the survey concludes. However, you can claim the prize right away by sending an email.

When you have answered the survey and wish to receive the reward, please send an email to me or if you filled the form with your name and email, wait my contact. I will send you a list of available reward games in the reply message. If you'd like a course product as your prize, the quickest way is to send a message via email, and I will send you a list of courses for which you can receive a code. You can also leave your contact information on the form that opens after completing the survey, and I will send you the list.


Have a great week ahead!


IcanY

notes.title: Welcome to Hardcore Trivia Store page
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/477a1ea70b481d3632ff570e3c40a19803c4943f.png[/img]

Hi and welcome to our Store Page!

We are currently working on a [b]Hardcore Trivia.[/b]
Hardcore Trivia is a fun and challenging game, which you can play on solo mode, with your friends or with a large amount of people. Challenge your brains and have a fun time with multiple challenging questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698910/Hardcore_Trivia/

Hardcore Trivia is aimed for two customer segments: 

[b]1:[/b] It offers a good entertainment for players on non-commercial version with a points calculation system. You can play it on solo-mode or get together to play with your friends. With multiple challenging questions, Hardcore Trivia put your brain to the test

[b]2:[/b] It is also suitable for companies and organisations, for example school clubs and pubs. If you are running a pub or school club, you can easily arrange an event where your host runs Hardcore Trivia and customers need to ques right answer. With Commercial licence, you can use ready-print questionnaire and offer a good entertainment to the customers.

[u]And best of all, you only need to buy Hardcore Trivia once, no monthly payments![/u]

[h2]Follow our new releases, updates and more:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40939311

[i][h3]Participating to Steam Next Fest - a celebration of upcoming games on October 2021![/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/85597a2a01d182354c03e9bb9ea0000ac544f586.png[/img]

We are glad to announce, that Hardcore Trivia is participating to Steam Next Fest. Steam Next Fest is a multi-day celebration where fans can try out demos, chat with developers, watch livestreams, and learn about upcoming games on Steam. 

Remember to add the game to your Wishlist! ːsteamhappyː

Best regards
[h3]F-Games[/h3]
